title: Hukam (urban sketch version)
music: soft synthesised harmonium drone, ducked under speech
topic: Hukam: a 57s devotional talk in romanised Punjabi on accepting both joy and sorrow (non-mortgage, not a client piece)
hook: Je sukh dey, taan tujhe aaraadhi, dukh bhi tujhe dhiyaayi.
logline: The same talk as hukam-reel in a sepia fineliner and watercolour sketchbook; colour is withheld and arrives with meaning: the lamp, the turban, the dawn.
structure: Layout 1080x1920: sketchbook page in the top 720px (sepia fineliner plus transparent watercolour that arrives with a wet front), the speaker's own video below, handwritten captions in the lower margin. 1367 frames at 24 fps.
device: colour withheld until it carries meaning (lamp, turban, dawn); watercolour wet-front; cream cold-press paper tooth multiplied over everything
lessons: Same audio and layout as hukam-reel; compare the two styles side by side before choosing.
24 fps; new work should be 30 fps.
